sections.title: What changed
items: Standup works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

changelog.title: The briefing catches up on paperwork

sections.title: What's new
items: No app changes — the wiki gains its missing next-tasks page, and the whole set now reaches installed copies that predate doc seeding.

sections.title: What's new
items: What needs you today, before you ask — your queue as a morning briefing.
